newsitem.title: FRANCE: French anti-terrorism judge probes ETA supporter.
newsitem.headline: French anti-terrorism judge probes ETA supporter.

text.p: A Paris anti-terrorism judge on Friday placed a French Basque believed linked to the ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) movement under investigation and ordered him held in preventive custody, justice sources said.

The sources said judge Laurence Le Vert ordered Egoitz Urruticoechea-Lasquibar, arrested on Saturday in the Pyrenees-Atlantiques in southwest France, on suspicion of conspiracy with a terrorist objective.

The son of an ETA leader who is jailed in Spain, the suspect belongs to a youth movement close to ETA, the sources said. The ETA has killed some 800 people in the 28 years it has been struggling for Basque independence.
